+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+//
+// VENDORED per-surface syntax/policy deltas for the FlatBars Lab's surface-aware
+// Reference popup. A pure projection of shared/surface-syntax.json — generated by
+// scripts/gen-surface-syntax.mjs, drift-gated by check:surface-syntax. DO NOT EDIT;
+// run `npm run gen:surface-syntax`. (Prod deploys only lab/, so the Lab cannot read
+// shared/ at runtime — this projection is how the single source reaches it.)
+export const SURFACE_SYNTAX = [
+  {
+    "id": "rawbars",
+    "label": "RawBars",
+    "engine": "rawbars",
+    "route": "/rawbars",
+    "tagline": "The desugared core surface — core skeleton syntax, no sugar.",
+    "compiles": true,
+    "truthiness": {
+      "rule": "nonEmpty",
+      "falsy": "false  null  \"\"  []  {}",
+      "note": "0 is truthy; empty containers are falsy"
+    },
+    "rows": [
+      {
+        "feature": "Output (raw only)",
+        "syntax": "{{{value}}}",
+        "note": "Triple-stash only; no {{ }} auto-escape shorthand.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Field access",
+        "syntax": "{{{(lookup this \"city\")}}}",
+        "note": "Explicit lookup helper; no dotted-path sugar.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Escaping",
+        "syntax": "{{{(escapeHtml x)}}}",
+        "note": "Manual — escaping is a helper, never implicit.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Subexpressions",
+        "syntax": "(upcase (lookup this \"name\"))",
+        "note": "Parens group a nested application into one argument.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Blocks",
+        "syntax": "{{#each xs}} … {{/each}}",
+        "note": "Core block; head is a helper application.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Inverse",
+        "syntax": "{{#unless ok}} … {{/unless}}",
+        "note": "Inverse via the unless helper — no {{^}} sigil.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Loop variables",
+        "syntax": "{{{index}}}  {{{first}}}  {{{key}}}",
+        "note": "Bare scoped ops: index, key, first, last, length. No @-data.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Comments",
+        "syntax": "{{! editorial note }}",
+        "note": "Dropped by the lexer.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Partials",
+        "syntax": "{{{(partial \"name\" this)}}}",
+        "note": "Called as the partial helper, unescaped.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      }
+    ]
+  },
+  {
+    "id": "fullbars",
+    "label": "FullBars",
+    "engine": "fullbars",
+    "route": "/fullbars",
+    "tagline": "The Handlebars-faithful surface — auto-escape, dotted paths, @-data.",
+    "compiles": true,
+    "truthiness": {
+      "rule": "handlebars",
+      "falsy": "false  null  0  \"\"  []",
+      "note": "{} is truthy; 0 is falsy unless includeZero=true"
+    },
+    "rows": [
+      {
+        "feature": "Output (auto-escape)",
+        "syntax": "{{value}}",
+        "note": "{{ }} auto-escapes; {{{ }}} or {{&value}} for raw.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Path access",
+        "syntax": "{{user.address.city}}",
+        "note": "Dotted paths, parent climb ../x, and @root.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Block params",
+        "syntax": "{{#each xs as |item i|}}",
+        "note": "Rename the loop bindings.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Subexpressions",
+        "syntax": "{{upcase (concat a b)}}",
+        "note": "Parens group nested applications.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "@-data variables",
+        "syntax": "{{@index}}  {{@key}}  {{@root}}",
+        "note": "Scoped data installed by each / with.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Partials",
+        "syntax": "{{> sidebar}}   {{> (lookup this \"p\")}}",
+        "note": "Surface sugar; desugars to the partial helper.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Else / inverse",
+        "syntax": "{{#each xs}} … {{else}} … {{/each}}",
+        "note": "{{else}} separator; {{^x}} inverted section.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Long comments",
+        "syntax": "{{!-- note with }} inside --}}",
+        "note": "Handles }} within the comment body.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      }
+    ]
+  },
+  {
+    "id": "maxbars",
+    "label": "MaxBars",
+    "engine": "maxbars",
+    "route": "/maxbars",
+    "tagline": "The flagship — FullBars plus infix operators and pipes.",
+    "compiles": true,
+    "truthiness": {
+      "rule": "nonEmpty",
+      "falsy": "false  null  \"\"  []  {}",
+      "note": "0 is truthy; same rule as RawBars"
+    },
+    "rows": [
+      {
+        "feature": "Infix operators",
+        "syntax": "{{price * qty}}   {{score >= 90}}",
+        "note": "Desugar to helpers: multiply, gte, and, or, not, coalesce.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Pipes",
+        "syntax": "{{name | upcase | truncate 8}}",
+        "note": "Left value becomes the helper's first argument.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Boolean / coalesce",
+        "syntax": "{{a && b}}   {{a ?? fallback}}",
+        "note": "&& || ! ?? as infix; group with parens.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Path access",
+        "syntax": "{{user.city}}   {{root.x}}   {{parent.x}}",
+        "note": "Reserved names instead of @root / ../  (no @-sigil).",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Loop variables",
+        "syntax": "{{index0}}   {{loop.first}}   {{outer.index0}}",
+        "note": "Bare scoped ops or labelled loop / outer chains (ADR-021).",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Block params",
+        "syntax": "{{#each xs as |item i|}}",
+        "note": "The as |…| bars are distinct from the pipe operator.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Output (auto-escape)",
+        "syntax": "{{value}}  /  {{{value}}}",
+        "note": "Inherits the FullBars escape model.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Inline / block partials",
+        "syntax": "{{#inline \"name\"}} … {{/inline}}   {{yield}}",
+        "note": "Bare yield (no @partial-block); rejects {{^}} and {{#*inline}}.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      }
+    ]
+  },
+  {
+    "id": "minbars",
+    "label": "MinBars",
+    "engine": "minbars",
+    "route": "/minbars",
+    "tagline": "Mustache-compatible — logic-less, sections, set-delimiters.",
+    "compiles": false,
+    "truthiness": {
+      "rule": "mustache-spec",
+      "falsy": "false  null  []",
+      "note": "0, \"\", {} are all truthy (the language-agnostic spec rule)"
+    },
+    "rows": [
+      {
+        "feature": "Output (auto-escape)",
+        "syntax": "{{value}}   {{{value}}}   {{&value}}",
+        "note": "{{ }} escapes; {{{ }}} and {{&}} are raw.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Sections",
+        "syntax": "{{#items}} … {{/items}}",
+        "note": "Shape decides: list iterates, truthy shows once.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Inverted sections",
+        "syntax": "{{^items}} none {{/items}}",
+        "note": "Renders when the value is falsy / empty.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Implicit iterator",
+        "syntax": "{{.}}",
+        "note": "The current scalar inside an array section.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Set delimiters",
+        "syntax": "{{=<% %>=}} … <% x %> … <%={{ }}=%>",
+        "note": "Switch the active pair mid-template — MinBars only (ADR-015).",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Partials",
+        "syntax": "{{> header}}",
+        "note": "Standalone; no context override in base Mustache.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Inheritance",
+        "syntax": "{{<base}} {{$block}} … {{/block}} {{/base}}",
+        "note": "Parent / block-override template inheritance.",
+        "kind": "only"
+      },
+      {
+        "feature": "Comments",
+        "syntax": "{{! note }}",
+        "note": "Dropped by the lexer.",
+        "kind": "shared"
+      }
+    ]
+  }
+];

+## 5.9 Surface deltas across the ladder
+
+The four surfaces share one engine and prelude; they differ in *surface syntax* and one
+value-policy axis (truthiness). The tables below are generated from the single source
+`shared/surface-syntax.json` — the same source the FlatBars Lab's surface-aware Reference popup
+and the tutorial reference pages read, so this reference can never drift from what those render.
+

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+{/* Generated from shared/surface-syntax.json by scripts/gen-surface-syntax.mjs — do not edit. */}
+{/* Regenerate with `npm run gen:surface-syntax`; CI checks it with `npm run check:surface-syntax`. */}
+
+### RawBars
+
+The desugared core surface — core skeleton syntax, no sugar. Truthiness: `nonEmpty` (falsy: `false  null  ""  []  {}` — 0 is truthy; empty containers are falsy).
+
+| Feature | Syntax | Notes |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Output (raw only) | `{{{value}}}` | Triple-stash only; no {{ }} auto-escape shorthand. |
+| Field access | `{{{(lookup this "city")}}}` | Explicit lookup helper; no dotted-path sugar. |
+| Escaping | `{{{(escapeHtml x)}}}` | Manual — escaping is a helper, never implicit. |
+| Subexpressions | `(upcase (lookup this "name"))` | Parens group a nested application into one argument. |
+| Blocks | `{{#each xs}} … {{/each}}` | Core block; head is a helper application. |
+| Inverse | `{{#unless ok}} … {{/unless}}` | Inverse via the unless helper — no {{^}} sigil. |
+| Loop variables | `{{{index}}}  {{{first}}}  {{{key}}}` | Bare scoped ops: index, key, first, last, length. No @-data. |
+| Comments | `{{! editorial note }}` | Dropped by the lexer. |
+| Partials | `{{{(partial "name" this)}}}` | Called as the partial helper, unescaped. |
+
+### FullBars
+
+The Handlebars-faithful surface — auto-escape, dotted paths, @-data. Truthiness: `handlebars` (falsy: `false  null  0  ""  []` — {} is truthy; 0 is falsy unless includeZero=true).
+
+| Feature | Syntax | Notes |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Output (auto-escape) | `{{value}}` | {{ }} auto-escapes; {{{ }}} or {{&value}} for raw. |
+| Path access | `{{user.address.city}}` | Dotted paths, parent climb ../x, and @root. |
+| Block params | `{{#each xs as \|item i\|}}` | Rename the loop bindings. |
+| Subexpressions | `{{upcase (concat a b)}}` | Parens group nested applications. |
+| @-data variables | `{{@index}}  {{@key}}  {{@root}}` | Scoped data installed by each / with. |
+| Partials | `{{> sidebar}}   {{> (lookup this "p")}}` | Surface sugar; desugars to the partial helper. |
+| Else / inverse | `{{#each xs}} … {{else}} … {{/each}}` | {{else}} separator; {{^x}} inverted section. |
+| Long comments | `{{!-- note with }} inside --}}` | Handles }} within the comment body. |
+
+### MaxBars
+
+The flagship — FullBars plus infix operators and pipes. Truthiness: `nonEmpty` (falsy: `false  null  ""  []  {}` — 0 is truthy; same rule as RawBars).
+
+| Feature | Syntax | Notes |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Infix operators | `{{price * qty}}   {{score >= 90}}` | Desugar to helpers: multiply, gte, and, or, not, coalesce. |
+| Pipes | `{{name \| upcase \| truncate 8}}` | Left value becomes the helper's first argument. |
+| Boolean / coalesce | `{{a && b}}   {{a ?? fallback}}` | && \|\| ! ?? as infix; group with parens. |
+| Path access | `{{user.city}}   {{root.x}}   {{parent.x}}` | Reserved names instead of @root / ../  (no @-sigil). |
+| Loop variables | `{{index0}}   {{loop.first}}   {{outer.index0}}` | Bare scoped ops or labelled loop / outer chains (ADR-021). |
+| Block params | `{{#each xs as \|item i\|}}` | The as \|…\| bars are distinct from the pipe operator. |
+| Output (auto-escape) | `{{value}}  /  {{{value}}}` | Inherits the FullBars escape model. |
+| Inline / block partials | `{{#inline "name"}} … {{/inline}}   {{yield}}` | Bare yield (no @partial-block); rejects {{^}} and {{#*inline}}. |
+
+### MinBars
+
+Mustache-compatible — logic-less, sections, set-delimiters. Truthiness: `mustache-spec` (falsy: `false  null  []` — 0, "", {} are all truthy (the language-agnostic spec rule)).
+
+| Feature | Syntax | Notes |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Output (auto-escape) | `{{value}}   {{{value}}}   {{&value}}` | {{ }} escapes; {{{ }}} and {{&}} are raw. |
+| Sections | `{{#items}} … {{/items}}` | Shape decides: list iterates, truthy shows once. |
+| Inverted sections | `{{^items}} none {{/items}}` | Renders when the value is falsy / empty. |
+| Implicit iterator | `{{.}}` | The current scalar inside an array section. |
+| Set delimiters | `{{=<% %>=}} … <% x %> … <%={{ }}=%>` | Switch the active pair mid-template — MinBars only (ADR-015). |
+| Partials | `{{> header}}` | Standalone; no context override in base Mustache. |
+| Inheritance | `{{<base}} {{$block}} … {{/block}} {{/base}}` | Parent / block-override template inheritance. |
+| Comments | `{{! note }}` | Dropped by the lexer. |
